set.body: Implement PRD RA-8: MarkSelector[K] as typed serializable data with RequireUnique/First/Last/Nth occurrence, EpochPlan with Window and PositiveSpan bin width, and FinalBin RequireExactDivision/IncludeShortFinal/ExcludeAndReport. Missing/ambiguous anchors name trial, selector and match count; excluded tails are data. Define checked Nth indexing and deterministic mark ordering. No closure-valued predicate or silent truncation. Acceptance: versioned codecs and pinned fixtures roundtrip every policy on JVM/JS; malformed policy/index inputs are named failures. Test clock mismatch, anchor overflow, exact/shorter-than-bin/non-divisible windows, half-open boundaries and independent accounting showing bins plus returned tail exactly partition the requested window. Exercise the executable selector-to-bins route and preserve missing trial anchors as errors. Existing temporal execution/persistence alone does not satisfy this task. FinalBin feeds eyesim-temporal per the baseline plan.
